name: creative-tab
blurb: Animated tab switcher with wobbly or hover-triggered animations.
description: Context-based tabs with motion. TabsProvider wraps TabsBtn and TabsContent. Supports wobbly indicator (spring animation) and hover triggering.
use_when: Design systems or showcases where animated tabs are a visual centerpiece.
avoid_when: Performance-critical UIs; animation adds rendering cost.
a11y: Tab buttons are keyboard-navigable with proper ARIA roles. Content regions properly associated.
